description: Family Rossi (Marco, Giulia and our two children). On the way to Milan Centrale on 3 March 2025 our taxi was hit by a van; Giulia and I were taken to the emergency room and the four of us missed the train to Zurich. Accident report from the police and booking attached. Only the two of us were injured; the children were fine.

documents.summary: A police report from the Polizia Locale di Milano dated 2025-03-03, filed by Marco Rossi, documenting a road traffic collision on Viale Lunigiana where a taxi was struck by a van, resulting in two injured passengers.
A booking confirmation from EuroTrips Travel GmbH for a trip from Milan to Zurich departing on 2025-03-03, with a total payment of EUR 800.00 and CFSR cover period from 2025-02-01 to 2025-04-10.

The booking confirmation (d2-booking-confirmation) confirms the route (Milan - Zurich), date (2025-03-03), and total paid (EUR 800.00), which aligns with the extracted facts and the description. decision.summary: Approved under Missed Departure or Missed Connection. Payout 400.00 EUR.
decision.explanation: Your claim for a missed departure has been approved for a payout of €400.00. We reviewed your police report, which confirms the traffic accident on 3 March 2025, and your booking confirmation for the Milan to Zurich train. These documents establish that you missed your scheduled departure due to a covered reason and that the incident occurred within your policy period. As the claim was submitted within the required timeframe and all necessary documentation was provided, no further action is needed.
